走廊尽头，1901。

门牌上只有简简单单的四个字：局长办公室。

李秘书力度适中的敲了两下。

“进。”

里面传来一个沉稳洪亮的声音。

李秘书推开门，侧身让路，对顾承安做了个“请”的手势。

顾承安迈步走了进去。

办公室不算太大，目测不超过30㎡，但空间利用得极为干净利落。

一张深色实木办公桌，桌面收拾得井井有条，最醒目的是两部座机和一面国旗摆件。

桌后是一面深色实木书柜，里面都摆满了，看得出来有翻过的痕迹，不是样品。

靠窗一组深色会客沙发，茶几上放着一套素色白瓷功夫茶具。

整个房间只有一处私人化的痕迹——书柜最上层放着一张合影，是一群身着老式军装的年轻士兵。

这就一瞬间的功夫。

何向东从办公桌后站了起来。

五十多岁的样子，身高一米七八，体型保持得不错，看得出有常年锻炼的习惯，白色短袖制式衬衫，肩上扛着二级警监的警衔，扎着制式腰带。

虽然是在自己办公室，但穿戴齐整，一丝不苟。

顾承安立正，敬了个标准的警礼。

何向东微微一怔，随即回了一个礼，然后笑着伸出手：“顾专员，别这么客气，坐坐坐。”

“何局长好。”顾承安伸手握了握。

李秘书已经在沏茶了，动作行云流水，从温杯到注水，全程没发出一点多余的声响。

很快一杯茶便递到了顾承安面前，一杯放到何向东手边，然后人就退了出去，顺手把门带上了。

“尝一尝这茶怎么样？这可是我的珍藏！”

“那我荣幸之至。”说着顾承安端起茶杯，先是打量了一下。

茶汤呈深琥珀色，油润透亮。

轻撮了一口。

“顾专员，茶怎么样？”

“好茶！入口沉稳内敛，回甘及久，乌岽单丛？”

何向东挑了下眉毛：“厉害，一下就品出来了，行家啊”

End of corridor, 1901.

There are only four simple words on the door plate: Director's Office.

Secretary Li knocked twice with moderate force.

"Come in."

A steady and loud voice came from inside.

Secretary Li pushed open the door, stepped aside to make way, and made a "please" gesture to Gu Chengan.

Gu Chengan stepped in.

The office is not too big, no more than 30 square meters by visual inspection, but the space is used extremely cleanly.

There is a dark solid wood desk with a neatly arranged tabletop. The most eye-catching items are two landline phones and a national flag ornament.

Behind the desk is a dark solid wood bookcase, which is full of books. It can be seen that there are signs of being turned over, so they are not samples.

There is a set of dark sofas by the window, and a set of plain white porcelain Kung Fu tea sets placed on the coffee table.

There is only one trace of personalization in the entire room - a group photo of a group of young soldiers wearing old-fashioned military uniforms is placed on the top shelf of the bookcase.

It only takes a moment.

He Xiangdong stood up from behind his desk.

He appears to be in his fifties, 1.78 meters tall, and has a well-maintained body shape. It can be seen that he has the habit of exercising all year round. He wears a white short-sleeved standard shirt, with the title of Second Class Police Superintendent on his shoulders and a standard belt.

Although he was in his own office, he was neatly dressed and meticulous.

Gu Chengan stood at attention and gave a standard police salute.

He Xiangdong was slightly startled, then returned the salute, then smiled and stretched out his hand: "Commissioner Gu, don't be so polite, just sit down."

"Hello, Director He." Gu Chengan stretched out his hand and shook it.

Secretary Li was already making tea, and he moved smoothly, from warming the cup to filling the water, without making any unnecessary noise.

Soon a cup of tea was handed to Gu Chengan, and a cup was placed in He Xiangdong's hand. Then he left and closed the door behind him.

"How about a taste of this tea? This is my treasure!"

"Then I'm honored." As he said this, Gu Chengan picked up the tea cup and looked at it first.

The tea soup is dark amber in color, oily and translucent.

Take a light sip.

"Commissioner Gu, how about tea?"

"Good tea! The entrance is calm and restrained, and the aftertaste is long-lasting. What about Wudong single bush?"

He Xiangdong raised his eyebrows: "Awesome, you can taste it right away, you're an expert."
